h1: Which room are you walking into?
p: Five decks, same product, different order of arguments. Every one opens with the spoken line that matches it and closes with a single sentence to end on.
p2: The live desk: journal, log, camera, illness check, coach, stories. Optional proof last. Crypto never leads.
p3: “One journal for the grow — tap a log, shoot a leaf, ask the coach.”
p5: What adoption actually is, how to follow a grow, four real transactions to open, and an honest limits slide before any ask.
p6: “Own the story of a real plant.”
p8: Journal-first evidence for future real-world assets. Honest status, a designed Devnet model, and a $150–200k pre-seed raise for legal path, Mainnet, and 30–50 growers.
p9: “Everyone tokenises a promise. We build the paper trail first.”
p11: Limits first: what we don’t claim, who you have to trust today, where that trust moves, the risk list, and how to verify everything yourself.
p14: For a Solana-native room. The gamification is the mint gate, the adopter stake, what is actually on devnet with addresses, why this needs a chain at all — and a status slide that says what is not done.
p15: “You can’t buy your way to a mint here.”
